title: Choose the visual direction for Jason Tseng's Portfolio
question: The roll assigned The Draftsman's Atelier (Architectural Studio Archive). Choose this direction, inspect the competitive alternate, or steer.

options.label: The Draftsman's Atelier
options.lineage: Architectural studio blueprint and master draftsman archive
options.thesis: Structural blueprint (Coder), expressive gestural draft (Artist), and programmatic notes (Writer) sharing one tactile, high-craft atelier plane.
options.viewport: Architectural header with registration coordinates and triad status; interactive WebGL mesh drafting field responding to the active discipline; high-contrast editorial typography with marginalia.
options.risk: Can veer too clinical if drafting geometry overpowers the warmth of the writing and visual artwork.

raised.raise: Depth is created through crisp structural plane overlaps and hairline drafting borders rather than generic blurry box-shadows.
Precise discipline node connectors that light up the underlying WebGL shader as the visitor navigates the triad.

options.label: The Computational Folio
options.lineage: Fine-press computational monograph (MIT Media Lab / Form+Code)
options.thesis: Publication-grade editorial elegance anchored by generous whitespace, ink-trap serif titling, and live reactive algorithmic canvas viewports.
options.viewport: Generous masthead with editorial serif type, triad navigation as table of contents, and an interactive Three.js fluid canvas framed in museum-grade borders.
options.risk: Familiar in elite design agency circles; requires extreme typographic discipline to avoid looking like a static magazine.

options.label: The Man-Machine Grid
options.lineage: Kraftwerk man-machine identity on strict modular traffic grid
options.thesis: Every discipline and project wired into a high-voltage, neon-accented schematic with strict orthogonal navigation.
options.viewport: Numbered coordinate grid with traffic signal indicators (Writer: Red, Artist: Amber, Coder: Green) pulsing through orthogonal wireframes.
options.case: Exceptional clarity and visceral resonance for engineering teams; slightly rigid for literary and expressive essays.
options.risk: High-voltage intensity can tire the reader on long essays.

options.label: Layered Papercut Roundel
options.lineage: Folded sheet papercuts with zero tonal shading
options.case: Visually striking for artwork, but unsuitable for code blocks, terminal logs, and technical case studies.
options.kept: Depth made solely through crisp physical overlaps without fuzzy shadows.

options.label: Drafted Pattern Envelope
options.lineage: Folded tissue patterns with nested cut lines
options.case: Poetic metaphor for craftsmanship, but unfamiliar to tech and software hiring leads.
options.kept: Dashed registration rules and nested discipline indicators.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: The modern clean portfolio template: dark glassmorphism card, gradient badge, and multi-role filters executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hero headline with gradient text accent, avatar with glowing halo, floating glass card container, and 3-column project grid.
canonCard.risk: Polished and predictable, looks like every other portfolio in the tech space.
